Trace 1 is empty, so there are no divergences to compare. Trace 2 attempts a BFS, correctly identifies M1 as unreachable, and finds the length 4 sequence.

⟦NONE⟧ trace=1 reason=<trace is empty>
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Is it possible I misread the mode transitions?" end="we can't use the -2 credit transition in M1." basis=Opens a branch checking if M1 is reachable, explores the transition rules, and explicitly eliminates M1 from consideration.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Could I do M0 -> M2 -> M3 -> M0 -> ... (length 4)" end="So step 3 must be A (or B)." basis=Opens a branch exploring the AAC path, calculates it, eliminates it, and concludes step 3 must be A.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's re-read carefully to ensure M1 isn't reachable." end="I will assume it's unreachable." basis=Re-executes the M1 reachability check that was already completed.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's verify the "Step 3" state." end="Yes, this works. AAAA." basis=Re-traces the AAAA path which was already calculated.
